objective.en: Find flooded New York neighbourhoods after Ida's record downpour and route help to basements and subways.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Observed rainfall, 31 Aug-3 Sep 2021 (remnants of Hurricane Ida). Flood cells are a heavy-rain PROXY, not mapped flood water: the wettest 20% of populated cells by IMERG event total (at least 125 mm). eventDay is the day a cell's cumulative IMERG rain first reached half its event total (mission day 0 = 2021-09-01; earlier lead-in rain counts as day 0).

sources.name: NASA SEDAC Gridded Population of the World v4, 2020 density (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Cells with at least 1000 people per square kilometre count as populated neighbourhoods.

sources.name: NASA MODIS NRT Global Flood Product, 2-day composite (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Cells with 20+ MODIS flood pixels (about 5% of the cell) in a composite after 2021-08-31, and almost none on 2021-08-31 (masks shoreline false alarms), are added as observed flood cells (20 cells). Checks: 2021-08-31 69% no-data, 0.1% flood; 2021-09-01 89% no-data, 0.0% flood; 2021-09-02 3% no-data, 0.2% flood; 2021-09-03 1% no-data, 0.9% flood.

sources.name: Cloud cover and sensor detectability (educational model)
sources.usage: Not observed: per-cell cloud probability is a model (storm-cloud base, higher where IMERG rain was heavier) and detectability is a seeded model. The heavy-rain-to-flood rule is also a simplification.
